_comment: Daily orchestrator (workshop/daily.mjs). NOT scheduled while "active" is false: no Windows task exists; "switchOn" holds the commands for the owner to approve. Two phases per video: day (idea -> script -> storyboard -> ONE script approval) and night (render -> QC -> publisher drafts -> ONE video approval). Publishing is core/publish-direct.mjs (autonomy below), never this script.
activated: AUTONOMOUS: 24/7, no schedule, auto-publish of QC-passed videos at least 60 min apart, until the owner says pause. Tasks: fabrication every 10 min, scripts every 30 min, publication every 10 min, every day.

autonomy._comment: publish: core/publish-direct.mjs sends every QC-passed video through Upload-Post (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok), no approval rows. min_gap_min never below 60. Pause: data/production-paused.json (vitrine button or the owner's 'pause'); 'reprends' removes it.
autonomy._resumed: A video goes out as soon as it is ready (within the gaps below).
autonomy._slowed: min_gap_min 100: about 15 stories a day, so TikTok (Upload-Post cap 15/24 h) and YouTube keep up. Catch-ups and the promo count inside each network cap (core/publish-direct.mjs holds()).

two_a_day._comment: 2 NEW videos a day, out at the slots below (studio time: core/local-config.mjs TIMEZONE, set by STUDIO_TIMEZONE or config.local.json "timezone", else this PC's zone). Videos made before keep going out every min_gap_min until the old stock is empty.
two_a_day._start: New production starts at start_at, ahead of the first slot.
two_a_day._volume: The team decides how many videos a day and when. The results analyst's daily 'SLOTS: …' line rewrites slots and per_day (workshop/story/hours.mjs): 1-8 a day, 1 h apart, the number at most once per 48 h; logged in data/decisions.jsonl.
two_a_day._no_higgsfield: No Higgsfield: made with local stills from the hero model sheet + slow zoom, the narrator voice, captions, full chain; 0 Higgsfield credits (workshop/story/animate.mjs DAY_CREDITS_MAX 0, not called).

scriptPhaseAt._comment: 2 scripts on Wed and Thu so Fri and Sat (no production) are covered: 1+1+1+2+2 = weeklyTarget.

quietHours._comment: Every day. core/db.mjs createApproval queues approvals in data/approvals-queue.jsonl during these hours; core/approval-waiter.mjs (one-off, detached) releases them at the end time.

publishSlots._comment: brand/lanes.md DAILY PICK SLOTS (adopted 2026-10-20): day offsets from the script day, nearer first; the 2nd script of the day takes the next free one. Sun-Tue today; Wed today + Fri; Thu today + Sat; Fri, Sat none. workshop/daily.mjs sets videos.planned_publish_date from it at script time.

proposed_start.night: every 30 min 00:30-14:00 Sun-Thu (renders whenever an approved script waits)

runs._comment: Share of core/agents-models.json limits.max_runs_per_day (40, unchanged) this orchestrator may use per local day: max_runs_share, or max_runs_share_by_day on 2-script days. needed = room a phase needs before it starts (retries included); a 2nd script the same day reuses that day's research (outlier_analyst, trend_scout, strategist, calendar_planner run once), so it only adds day_extra_script.

_comment_plan_order: 2026-10-21 (brand/lanes.md v2): research before topic_editor runs once per day run; topic_editor then picks ONE slot per run of it and answers "{slot} | {lane} | {topic}"; workshop/daily.mjs creates the video. strategist and calendar_planner run once per day run in REPORT-ONLY mode (2026-10-21): a log_event note + data/daily/<date>-<agent>.md, never a video row; topic_editor stays the only picker and must come last.

render._comment: Night render: pipeline keyframes -> continuity_checker agent (keyframe gate) -> pipeline clips,overlays,sound,assembly,qc. Method img2img = the ep01 way (Z-Image img2img from per-shot composite guides, then Wan 2.2 at 6 steps).
render._comment_dry_run: dry_run_clip_minutes: simulated Wan clip time in --dry-run only (moves the schedule clock, never sleeps).

switchOn._comment: NOT RUN. For the owner to approve, then paste in cmd.exe (not PowerShell: it mangles the \" quotes), then set "active": true. /IT = only when you are logged on; /RL LIMITED = no highest privileges. schtasks has no working-directory option, hence cmd /c "cd /d ... && ...". fabrication repeats every 30 min from 00:30 for 13:30 (last start 14:00): a run with nothing to do exits quietly; while one instance renders, the next start is skipped (task default "do not start a new instance" + the per-phase lock). Remove: schtasks /Delete /TN "<name>" /F Replace <studio folder> with the folder of this studio; node must be on the PATH.
switchOn.scripts: schtasks /Create /TN "Faceless Studio - scripts" /SC WEEKLY /D SUN,MON,TUE,WED,THU /ST 06:00 /TR "cmd /c \"cd /d \"<studio folder>\" && node --no-warnings workshop\daily.mjs --phase day\"" /IT /RL LIMITED
switchOn.fabrication: schtasks /Create /TN "Faceless Studio - fabrication" /SC WEEKLY /D SUN,MON,TUE,WED,THU /ST 00:30 /RI 30 /DU 13:30 /TR "cmd /c \"cd /d \"<studio folder>\" && node --no-warnings workshop\daily.mjs --phase night\"" /IT /RL LIMITED
